schema.title: Response List Archived V1 Archive Get

post.description: What was known about a node at a date: recorded by then, not closed by then.

schema.title: Response Known At V1 At Post

put.description:
Change the mode (persisted: a paused service comes back paused) and the
concurrency toward each model endpoint (P11).

schema.title: Response Update Background V1 Background Put

post.description: The foreground turn is done: background model calls may start again.

schema.title: Response Resume Background V1 Background Resume Post

post.description:
Process the queue now, under an optional budget (calls, tokens, seconds,
jobs); answers with a run id and what it processed. Refused while paused.

schema.title: Response Run Background V1 Background Run Post

post.description:
A foreground turn starts: the worker finishes its current model call and
starts no other until ``resume`` or ``timeout_seconds`` pass.

schema.title: Response Yield Background V1 Background Yield Post

post.description:
Start a run (SPEC 5.6): recorded and queued at once, executed by the
background worker under the mode, the gate and ``yield`` (P11).

schema.title: Response Start Dream V1 Dream Post
Response Get Dream V1 Dream  Run Id  Get

post.description:
Stop a dream cleanly: a pending one never starts, a running one stops at
its next unit, as at a budget limit.

schema.title: Response Cancel Dream V1 Dream  Run Id  Cancel Post

get.description:
The run's operations in order, each with what became of it and why
(content: the model's texts and reasons), paginated and under budget.

schema.title: Response Dream Plan V1 Dream  Run Id  Plan Get

post.description: Revert a run (all or nothing) or one of its operations (SPEC 5.6 rule 4).

schema.title: Response Undo Dream V1 Dream  Run Id  Undo Post
Response Patch Fact V1 Facts  Fact Id  Patch

get.description:
Tier, configured backends, the queue (depth and oldest pending item, so a
paused queue never fills in silence, P11) and the background mode. Answering
makes no model call.

``external_id`` -> the visible records carrying it; ``name`` -> the visible
nodes with that name or alias (exactly one of the two).

schema.title: Response Get Node V1 Nodes  Node Id  Get

post.description:
How two nodes are related: the shortest path over visible, live edges,
at most ``max_hops`` long, delivered whole or not at all under the budget.

schema.title: Response Find Path V1 Path Post

post.description:
The harness is about to compact: the messages it will drop are queued for
extraction, and a short block of what must survive comes back under budget.
The route is a write; the block needs ``read`` too and is empty without it.

schema.title: Response List Probe Sets V1 Probes Get

post.description:
Store a probe set (SPEC 11.2). Its expected records must be visible from its
scope; changing what gates a dream is the ``dream`` permission's.

schema.title: Response Create Probe Set V1 Probes Post
Response Delete Probe Set V1 Probes  Set Id  Delete
Response Get Probe Set V1 Probes  Set Id  Get

post.description: Run a probe set now: the probe score (SPEC 11.2), ids and numbers only.

schema.title: Response Run Probes V1 Probes  Set Id  Run Post

get.description:
The pending proposals visible in the view, oldest first, under budget
(SPEC 4.4b, 8.3): the only place a fact proposal without a node shows.

schema.title: Response List Proposals V1 Proposals Get

post.description:
Accept (apply: an alias proposal adds the alias, a fact proposal writes an
explicit fact) or reject a proposal (SPEC 4.4b), by a token bound to one of its
scopes; a decided one is not decided again. A fact proposal - a fact about the
owner that was not the owner's words (P6) - is decided only with ``review``:
an agent fooled by the page it came from must neither apply nor hide it.

schema.title: Response Decide Proposal V1 Proposals  Proposal Id  Post

get.description:
One queue (SPEC 4.4b, 8.6): pending alias, fact and merge proposals and
queued dream operations the view sees, oldest first, under budget. A merge
proposal carries the latest adjudication of its pair, and stands aside when
its merge_nodes is queued (that item carries the same verdict).

schema.title: Response Review Queue V1 Review Get

post.description:
Accept or reject one item of the queue: a proposal, or a queued operation
- checked again against memory as it is now (rule 8: ``stale`` is a 409).

schema.title: Response Decide Review Item V1 Review  Item Id  Post

post.description: Flush and extract the session: queued, processed in the background.

schema.title: Response Session End V1 Session End Post

post.description:
The profile block: pinned facts and the most central nodes of the view,
under budget, deterministic and stable while nothing changes.

schema.title: Response Session Start V1 Session Start Post

post.description: Fact changes of a node, or of the whole view, inside a date range (P7).
Record a turn: one insert into the persisted queue, nothing else (P3).

schema.title: Response Record Turn V1 Turns Post
